integrity: The theorem, algebraic argument, and Python standard-library consistency checker have undergone self-review. The checker tests finite samples and does not certify an infinite-parameter theorem. Literature comparison is not a mathematical proof of novelty; independent scientific review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two coupled Brownian coordinates with harmonic thermal coupling, one bath relaxation time, and independent Poisson resetting of the probe coordinate only. The fixed-positive-lag covariance and fixed-frequency power-spectrum limits are not uniform down to zero lag or over frequencies growing with reset rate. The theorem concerns second-order stationarity, not the full stationary distribution or multi-mode baths.
title: A persistent Lorentzian memory footprint under arbitrarily rapid probe-only resetting
